_about: One entry per option shown on the phone for every photo. crop: true = auto-crop around the subject (subject fills ~1/3 of the frame, more detail); false = the whole photo. style: settings passed to explore.py (hydrant technique + route order). Add, remove or reorder entries freely; ids must be short and unique.
